listing.name: Armored Core: Last Raven Portable — last-raven-recomp (Sifayne)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, movies, the title screen and a runtime. Mission gameplay is not confirmed here; check the project’s status notes before setup. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PSP disc and decrypted inputs. The required serial number and revision are not confirmed; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local game-build instructions with your own inputs. The standalone AppImage launcher contains no game assets; preparing the game still requires your own files.
